newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Development Bank to repay CFTIC debts.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Development Bank to repay CFTIC debts.

text.p: China's Guangdong Development Bank will repay debts of the China Finance Trust and Investment Corperation after completing a three-month liquidation of the investment entity, the China Securities said on Friday.
The debt would be paid at the interest set by the central bank, the newspaper quoted the development bank official as saying.
Priority for the repayment of principal would be given to domestic individual depositors, and then enterprises and financial institutions would be paid, it said but did not give further details.

The People's Bank of China, the central bank, had announced the end of its management of China Finance and approved the development bank in southern China's Guangdong province to purchase the Beijing-based investment firm on October 5, 1996, the newspaper said.

The central bank on October 6, 1995 closed China Finance and took over its management because of illegal and irregular business practices that had resulted in enormous debts that the investment firm was unable to repay, the newspaper said.
China Finance had investments in securities and real estate.
